floor_selection: SHA256(R91-floor-v1:case), 3 cases each from categories 0/1; 2 each from 2..8; independent of scores
permutation: Two SHA256-index permutations of all 4096 values, keyed by case, generation seed and draw 9001/9002; fixed across steps; target-derived histogram retained
inference: Average seeds/draws within source; source is sampling unit. Added-seed replication primary is REQ_U-U25. Original two-seed result stays separate. Five-seed pooled estimate is an updated sensitivity result. Mixed model on paired differences is secondary; five seeds give imprecise seed-variance estimation.
restrictions: No new editor, dataset, beta, net displacement, executed dose arm or human/model ratings. No claim of perceptual equivalence from nonsignificance. No regeneration of the missing 960 historical images.
historical_reuse: Old seeds use archived exact per-pair profiles. Baseline scores are archived, not rerun; four native sentinels check environment compatibility. A failure stops new generation.
outputs: Every new native 512 PNG, map, config, profile and evaluator row retained. Compact and full-native ZIPs exported separately.
